department: Zachry Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 15 for all assistantships and fellowships; fall applications without aid are accepted until April 15 for internationals.
deadline.quote: To be eligible for all teaching assistantships, research assistantships and fellowships, you must apply by December 15 for admission the following fall semester. Applications for the fall semester not seeking financial aid will continue to be accepted until April 15 for international applicants

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You don't pick a faculty member when applying; an initial advisor is assigned after admission.
supervisor.quote: select a faculty member as part of the application? No. Students will be assigned an initial advisor once admitted

funding.value: Admission does not guarantee funding; admitted students are considered for all assistantships and fellowships.
funding.quote: Will admission into the program guarantee me some form of funding? No. Admission and funding are separate issues.

entry_route.value: You can apply straight from a bachelor's; if not admitted to the PhD, you are considered for the master's.
entry_route.quote: You can apply directly to the Ph.D. program from your undergraduate degree without completing a master's degree.

app_fee.value: International applicants pay $148: the $90 Texas A&M fee plus the $58 EngineeringCAS fee.
app_fee.quote: International Applicants: $148 - Texas A&M University fee ($90) + EngineeringCAS Processing Fee ($58)

fee_waiver.value: The department cannot waive the application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: Unfortunately, no. The application fee is set by EngineeringCAS and Texas A&M University.

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) are no longer required.

notes: Applications via EngineeringCAS. Offers an Artificial Intelligence and Data Science specialty within the civil engineering PhD.
